name: context-manager
description: On every compaction a cheap model (Haiku by default) writes a cumulative summary of the whole session, the main model writes only a short summary of recent work, and the session_recall tool searches the original transcript for exact old facts.

python.title: Python 3 command
python.description: The command that starts Python 3.9 or newer: python3 on macOS and Linux; python or py on Windows. A full path also works.
